items.title: Trump says US will hit Iran 'hard' again today
items.description: The US president warns Iran "will have to pay the price" for taking too long to agree a deal, after Tehran vows retaliation to any attacks.

items.title: Three Indian sailors missing after US says it hit tanker in Gulf of Oman
items.description: India's government said three Indian sailors were missing and 21 crew had been rescued after the hit on the Settebello off the coast of Oman.

items.title: Fireworks illuminate Barcelona's Sagrada Família during Pope visit
items.description: Pope Leo XIV says Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Família is a masterpiece of "stones, colours and light" during his visit to Spain.

items.title: Whale graveyard dating back five million years discovered
items.description: The Indian Ocean site is "far beyond anything we had imagined", one researcher says.

items.title: Bill Gates says Epstein wanted personal relationship, but he 'never reciprocated'
items.description: The Microsoft co-founder spent hours talking to lawmakers behind closed doors, where he also said Epstein used his marital infidelities to pressure him.

items.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 17, reports say
items.description: Nine of them were killed in a series of attacks in the town of Tayr Debba, according to Lebanon's state news agency.

items.title: US official claims banned referee had links with 'terror organisations'
items.description: Somali referee Omar Artan was denied entry to the United States because of his "association with suspected members of terror organisations," says a US official.

items.title: French singer Patrick Bruel faces rape charges
items.description: Bruel has been placed under judicial investigation, which means an examining magistrate will look more deeply into the case.

items.title: Norway crown princess's son to stay in custody before rape verdict, says court
items.description: Thr ruling overturns a lower court's decision on Monday ordering the release of the crown princess's 29-year-old son.

items.title: Pakistan launches deadly air strikes in Afghanistan, reigniting tensions
items.description: The fresh strikes come after weeks of relative calm in the restive border region between the two countries.

items.title: First charges laid over deadly Hong Kong fire
items.description: The Wang Fuk Court blaze last year was the deadliest that Hong Kong had seen in 70 years, killing 168 people.

items.title: Ukraine says missiles hit military plant deep inside Russia
items.description: Ukraine's military also says it has struck a Russian oil refinery and a "shadow fleet" oil tanker in the Black Sea.
